Officer's Crash Report Narrative
On arrival at the intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, I observed a side-impact collision between two passenger
vehicles. Driver 1 was operating the vehicle that struck the driver's side of Driver 2's vehicle as Driver 2 proceeded
through the intersection. Passenger was seated in the front psasenger position of Drvier 2's vehicle and was
identified at the scene by both drivers and by two independent witnesses who had observed the collision from the
sidewalk.
Both witnesses stated that the collision occurred as described by Driver 2, and Driver 1 acknowledged the sequence
of events when interviewed. Scene phootgraphs taken at the time show damage concentrated along the driver's side
of Driver 2's vehicle, consistent with the direction and force of the impact. Driver 2 reported a wrist injury sustained
during the collision, and the nature of that injury is consistent with the forces involved given the point of contact within
the cabin. I found no indication of prior damage to either vehicle at the scene, and no party reported any earlier
incident invovling Driver 2's vehicle. Driver 2 is listed as the named insured on the applicable policy, as confirmed
from documentation provided at the scene.
